event: Ada Vane returned to Saltreach and resumed contact with Mara Quill and Joss Vane.
date_note: Opening day of story-1, twenty-one years after Ada left the island

event: Joss admitted that his hands had deteriorated since March and that he could no longer keep the lighthouse alone.
Ada assumed the full night watch, trimmed the lighthouse wicks, and began making entries in the current logbook.
